title: Rams shut out Saints as Stetson Bennett, CJ Daniels put on a preseason show

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams shut out Saints as Stetson Bennett, CJ Daniels put on a preseason show
sources.description: Stetson Bennett capitalizes on extended playing time, leading four scoring drives and rushing for two touchdowns in the Rams' 34-0 preseason win over the Saints.
